nodes.label: frontend-design skill
nodes.rationale: Guides distinctive, intentional visual design that avoids templated AI-default looks; the hero is a thesis, typography carries personality, spend boldness in one signature element.

nodes.label: speckit-analyze command
nodes.rationale: Strictly read-only cross-artifact consistency/quality analysis across spec.md, plan.md, tasks.md; runs only after tasks generation and never modifies files.

nodes.label: speckit-checklist command
nodes.rationale: Checklists are 'unit tests for English' that validate requirements quality (completeness, clarity, consistency), not implementation behavior.

nodes.label: speckit-clarify command
nodes.rationale: Detects and reduces spec ambiguity via up to 5 targeted questions, encoding answers back into the spec before planning to reduce downstream rework.

nodes.label: speckit-constitution command
nodes.rationale: Fills the constitution template with concrete principles and propagates amendments across dependent plan/spec/tasks templates using semantic-version bumps.

nodes.label: speckit-converge command
nodes.rationale: Append-only assessment of codebase vs spec/plan/tasks that adds remaining unbuilt work as new tasks so implement can finish; never rewrites existing tasks or code.

nodes.label: speckit-implement command
nodes.rationale: Executes all tasks in tasks.md phase-by-phase, respecting dependencies and TDD ordering, and marks completed tasks [X].

nodes.label: speckit-plan command
nodes.rationale: Runs the planning workflow from the plan template to produce research.md, data-model.md, contracts/, and quickstart.md with constitution gate checks.

nodes.label: speckit-specify command
nodes.rationale: Creates the feature spec from a natural-language description using the spec template; focuses on WHAT/WHY, limits to 3 clarification markers, and validates via a quality checklist.

nodes.label: speckit-tasks command
nodes.rationale: Generates a dependency-ordered tasks.md organized by user story from plan/spec/design artifacts, using the strict checklist task format for independent testability.

nodes.label: speckit-taskstoissues command
nodes.rationale: Converts tasks.md entries into deduplicated GitHub issues via the GitHub MCP server, only when the git remote is a GitHub URL.

nodes.label: Spec Kit Full SDD Cycle workflow
nodes.author: GitHub
nodes.rationale: Orchestrates specify -> plan -> tasks -> implement with manual review gates (review-spec, review-plan) that abort on reject; requires speckit >=0.8.5 and any initialized integration.
